description: 10-item boolean gate checklist. Run before every commit. All blocking items must pass.

items.name: vocab-check
items.description: All terms exist in data/vocabulary/ or core/categories/

items.name: pos-check
items.description: No noun used as verb, no verb used as noun

items.name: synonym-check
items.description: No non-ste terms from synonym-table.json present in output

items.name: sentence-length
items.description: No procedural sentence > 20 words, no descriptive sentence > 25 words

items.name: active-voice
items.description: No passive voice in procedural sections

items.name: one-term-per-concept
items.description: No synonym drift across the document

items.name: code-block-lang
items.description: All code blocks have language identifiers

items.name: pronoun-check
items.description: No ambiguous pronouns (it, this, that) without clear referents

items.name: breaking-format
items.description: All BREAKING/DEPRECATED notices include version and migration path
